description: Defines a custom SwipeRefreshLayout subclass supporting multiple child views for refresh gesture triggering, with methods to set swipeable children and determine scrollability.

classes.name: MultiSwipeRefreshLayout
classes.description: A custom layout extending SwipeRefreshLayout to support multiple swipeable child views.

methods.name: setSwipeableChildren
methods.description: Sets the child views that can trigger a refresh gesture based on their IDs.

methods.name: canChildScrollUp
methods.description: Determines if any swipeable child can scroll up, controlling when the refresh gesture can start.

methods.name: canViewScrollUp
methods.description: Utility method to check if a specific view can scroll up, handling different Android versions and view types.
